name: Himekishi Ashley Inmon Monogatari
original_name: 姫騎士アシュリー淫紋物語
source:
A world that is filled with strife, with mankind fighting against monsters and their fellow humans, which caused a loss of many lives. 

Mankind is protected by the "Rose Knights", individuals who are blessed with the Sacred Power. 

However, even that hope is taken away... 

Humans and monsters took over the world as they defeated the princess knights. Will the girls be able to carry out their faith, or maybe...

Her name is Ashley. Ashley Hornet, a rose knight princess who lives in the Capital Gleotos. The story starts from there...

[Translated from [url=http://noblecat-soft.com/himekishiinmon/index.html#sto]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
这是一个充满纷争的世界：人类与怪物及同类交战，导致无数生命消逝。

人类受到“玫瑰骑士”保护，他们是获得神圣力量祝福的人。

然而，就连这份希望也被夺走……

人类与怪物击败了公主骑士，接管了世界。女孩们能坚持自己的信念吗，还是会……

她的名字叫艾希莉。艾希莉·霍尼特，一位生活在格莱奥托斯首都的玫瑰骑士公主。故事从这里开始……

（译自[url=http://noblecat-soft.com/himekishiinmon/index.html#sto]官方网站[/url]）
